en.headline: SmarTone network instability affects some areas this afternoon
en.dek: Users reported loss of mobile service from around 2:30pm; the company said services were recovering by mid-afternoon and apologised.
body: SmarTone said it had noticed instability in network services in some areas on Thursday afternoon and was actively investigating. The company stated it was working to minimise the impact on customers and would provide further updates in due course.

Reports from users began around 2:30pm, with some phones displaying no service and an inability to make calls or use mobile data. Monitoring sites recorded a sharp rise in incident reports at that time. Services started to recover progressively, and by about 3:45pm affected networks were returning to normal, according to the operator.

SmarTone advised customers who were still unable to connect to restart their phones or toggle flight mode. The company again apologised for the inconvenience. The exact cause had not been disclosed by late afternoon.

zh.headline: 數碼通部分地區網絡不穩 服務陸續恢復
zh.dek: 下午約2時半起有用戶報稱訊號中斷，公司表示正調查，至約3時45分逐步恢復並致歉。
body: 數碼通表示，留意到周四下午部分地區的網絡服務出現不穩定情況，現正積極調查及跟進，並會盡力減低對客戶的影響。公司指如有進一步消息會適時公布，就造成不便深表歉意。
用戶報告約於下午2時半開始湧現，部分手機顯示沒有服務，無法通話或使用流動數據。監察網站同期錄得事故報告急增。營運商其後表示，早前受影響的網絡服務已陸續恢復正常，至約3時45分情況改善。
數碼通建議仍未能正常使用服務的客戶重新啟動手機，或開關飛行模式。截至下午稍後時間，公司尚未公布故障的具體原因。
